Before scoring, record the mechanism, comparator, cohort, shuffled order and seed, numerical prediction with an 80% interval, and the observation that would refute it. Then append the result, changed decisions, paired uncertainty and validation limits. Score a new component with the full system that will use it. Score a whole alternative end to end.

## F1 / F2 · Whole waveform decoder with session prototypes

Registered 18 November 2026 before any held score. In both arms, train an entire fast decoder from the official EEG tensor. The encoder learns spatial projections of the complex Fourier coefficients, then reads eight bands of log power and relative power. Mixing sensors before computing power preserves signed cross-channel relationships. A static head supplies soft pseudo-classes. At inference only already delivered EEG updates class-specific embedding sums, pseudo-counts and a shared session context. Shrink all context toward zero at the start of a session. Unlike the spectral kernel in §454, the decoder stores a fixed-size summary and learns its signal representation and readout jointly. The waveform studies §439/441 tested gain augmentation with a different memory, and §449 centered A6 writes after fitting. F2 tests subtracting the static head's expected class embedding from the shared context write during end-to-end learning. That change tests whether earlier trials indicate session style after removing predicted task composition. The prototype writes remain identical in form. Both arms train the same auxiliary class templates and have the same optimizer, episodes and seeds.

- Fit the other nine people in each public fold, with balanced interface/class source loss, 600 shuffled single-session episodes of 96 unique windows, two seeds (460 and 1460), AdamW 0.001 with weight decay 0.001. F1 is `prototype`, F2 is `centered`. Freeze the trained model before opening any held labels. Replay ten held people and all eight pinned §430 deliveries on Galvani. P04/P10 here are held-new roles.
- Compare whole waveform scores for genuine history, an equal-age cyclic source-session donor (different person, fixed canonical source session) and blank history. Also test each decoder as one terminal member of the complete historical three-eye/three-rest cap250 (§430): add 0.20 times the decoder's centered raw logits clipped to ±3 to the authenticated terminal log probabilities. Preserve all upstream stages and routes. Include exact-zero stock and matched decoder donor and blank arms. No blend weight selection.
- F1 predictions in percentage points: whole genuine minus donor +1.2 (80% −0.7 to +3.1), whole genuine minus blank +0.8 (−0.8 to +2.4), full-stack genuine minus stock +0.20 (−0.45 to +0.85), full-stack genuine minus blank +0.10 (−0.3 to +0.5). F2 predictions: F2 minus F1 full-stack genuine +0.12 (−0.35 to +0.59), improvement over matched blank specifically +0.10 (−0.35 to +0.55), F2 full-stack genuine minus stock +0.30 (−0.45 to +1.05). Positive paired people/order 80% lower bounds at both seeds support a directional claim, nonpositive uppers at both refute it, otherwise undecided. A whole replacement needs at least stock point performance before external qualification. Any additive result here must pass an independent cohort and actual staged ZIP evaluation before release. No private claims or upload.
- Require hashes of the EEG, order bank, source, weights and decisions. Check finite active gradients, nonzero parameters updates and history response, exact first-window and reset identity, one-window and prefix equivalence, no held training labels, reproduction of every stock label and canonical ages. Verify the official score and fresh historical replay OK. Compare paired one-window A100 throughput before release. Ferranti source/behavior smoke, then two 20-fit arrays at up to six jobs each, five-minute limit per task. Galvani independent scorer reads only pinned checkpoints and permitted public data. Retain source receipts and failed stages.

## F3 / F4 · Learn where within the EEG window the signal changes

Registered 18 November 2026 before opening scores for these actors. The F1 waveform encoder discards changes across the four seconds before reading band power. Within-window progression may separate lexical retrieval from sustained imagery or arithmetic. §389b split class-conditioned autoregression into halves and its timing effect varied by seed. §380 used multiscale carriers and a short-branch permutation. F3 retains waveform-trained spatial projections and prototypes and learns on two independent contrasts of four one-second power frames. Both arms see the identical whole-window spectrum and amplitudes. `chronological` receives signed late-minus-early and interior-minus-edge power contrasts. `symmetric` receives absolute late-minus-early and signed interior-minus-edge contrasts. The latter is invariant under frame reversal, including within the first/last pair. Both have the same capacity, initialization, source rows, shuffle and training budget. FFT magnitudes alone cannot resolve the direction of the discarded contrast. The signal model may learn artifacts in fixed post-cue timing, so a positive result advances only with the perturbation control below and external verification.

- F3 predicts chronological minus symmetric +0.75 pp (80% −0.75 to +2.25) whole genuine, +0.12 (−0.40 to +0.64) in full cap250 insertion, and +0.10 (−0.40 to +0.60) whole history-specific difference in differences. Keep F1's fit/exclusion/eight canonical deliveries/common metric/terminal weight/control seeds and check independent direct frame reversal. Both seed lower 80% endpoints above zero support a directional contrast, both uppers at or below zero refute it, otherwise undecided.
- F4 trains the same chronological model after shifting within-window source frames by −30/−15/0/15/30 samples (−250 to +250 ms at 120 Hz) with reflection at the true window edges. Each block of five episodes gives every within-episode position each shift once. `coherent_time` shares an offset across the episode and `scattered_time` rotates the same block's offsets across windows. Episode rows, seeds and steps are identical to F3. Evaluate original, unshifted probe tensors only. Predict coherent minus scattered +0.45 pp (−0.8 to +1.7) whole genuine, +0.10 (−0.45 to +0.65) full genuine, and coherent minus unaugmented chronological +0.10 (−0.45 to +0.65) full genuine. Also report both crossed genuine-minus-blank changes to locate memory dependence. Same uncertainty rule, no adaptation to held labels or score-selected results.
- Four 20-fit arrays capped at four concurrent each, following one 4-step real H100 smoke per arm. Fit wave F4 after F3 begins. Pair candidate controls in independent Galvani held-person full-stack replays and record whole decoder evidence separately. Source code, data, epoch steps, fit exclusion, independent prefix/reset/single-window checks and blind score bank are mandatory. Reserve paired A100 timing before any release. No upload.

**F-C1 completed.** Galvani 3127070/3127088/3127089 reported replay OK and full controls. Primary vs stock −0.110 pp for held-new and −0.098 pp for returning, both paired intervals touching or crossing zero. The preregistered activation condition for exact-package qualification did not pass. [Report](../friday/cap250-c1-result.md)

## F5 · Train a waveform correction on fit-excluded cap250 mistakes

Registered 18 November 2026 before training and external scoring. F1's waveform member reduced full public cap250 performance. F5 trains the chronological waveform encoder and causal prototypes to correct the historical three-eye/three-rest cap250 posterior directly. §376 used a spectral proxy and frozen representation. F5 uses actual historical fit-excluded predictions and trains the entire waveform decoder. All ten public people are training data. The holdout is independent Scherer EEG in the exact staged cap250 worker. §430 route and component-order caveats apply to the training supervision.

- Match seeds 460/1460, initialization, class/interface-balanced loss, 600 complete source sessions sampled from the eight pinned orders, AdamW 0.001/0.001. Map cap250 outputs by row and stream age. Train with cross-entropy after adding 0.20 times centered raw waveform logits clipped to ±3. The `true` arm uses actual cap250 log posteriors and `wrongswap` swaps the two incorrect class logits per source window. The swap preserves true-class probability, confidence distribution, entropy and the incumbent error indicator. `ordinary` uses waveform CE alone. All arms have the same static and template auxiliary losses. Training uses no Scherer waveform or labels.
- Compare full terminal insertions with genuine or blank history. Score two canonical Scherer orders and both days of all nine people against staged stock. Predict true−wrongswap +0.20 pp (80% −0.60 to +1.00), true−ordinary +0.55 (−0.30 to +1.40), true−stock +0.18 (−0.60 to +0.96). Positive lower paired people/order bounds on both seeds support a contrast, nonpositive uppers on both refute it, otherwise undecided. Genuine minus blank is secondary. Source losses measure optimization.
- Galvani CPU extraction authenticates §430, pinned ages, unchanged decisions and fresh replay OK. Ferranti four-step real smoke per objective, then six five-minute H100 jobs. Record source/weight hashes, parameter updates, corruption parity and one-window equivalence. Real external smoke in clean A100 worker, nine paired workers and collector. Require stock/zero identity, order/counter match and blind decision proof. No upload.

## F6 · Supervised motor imagery pretraining across corpora

Registered 18 November 2026 after F1–F4, before F6 fitting. The preceding compact decoders used true history to improve on some blank controls, but all full-stack insertions trailed cap250. F6 tests whether supervised sensorimotor pretraining supplies a missing representation. Pretrain the chronological encoder and spatial projections on five motor/rest targets from PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery v1.0.0, subjects 1–30, three existing exports, 5,220 windows with no channel interpolation. Restrict pretraining to spectra from 7 to below 30 Hz to favor sensorimotor rhythms. Use unchanged PROTEUS EEG at fine-tune and replay. §277 used self-supervised reconstruction and contrastive learning.

- Pretrain `motor_transfer` with authentic labels and `motor_null` with within-person/run target permutations. Both arms use identical inputs, label counts, initialization, and 1,200 updates (AdamW 0.001, decay 0.001, batch 96). Discard the external head. Refit the entire chronological decoder with the F3 source-held PROTEUS recipe, 600 updates and seeds 460/1460 on Ferranti. Replay ten held folds and eight pinned orders, whole model and full three-seed cap250. Compare also with the authenticated F3 no-pretrain chronological result.
- Predict authentic minus shuffled +1.5 pp (80% −0.5 to +3.5) whole, +0.15 (−0.35 to +0.65) full, +2.0 (−1.0 to +5.0) whole motor imagery recall and +0.30 (−0.4 to +1.0) full motor recall. Both positive lower paired people/order bounds support, both nonpositive uppers refute, otherwise undecided. A full insertion that trails stock does not advance. Source pretraining loss measures optimization only.
- Galvani A100 real smoke and four max-five-minute fits, Ferranti real smokes and two 20-fit arrays at four simultaneous tasks each, Galvani independent per-fold scorer. Authenticate training source, external shards, pretraining and final held-excluded weights. No upload.

## F7 · One raw-waveform decoder with a masked latent training target

Registered 18 November 2026 before fitting. Sebastian chose best whole-model score on unseen people as the primary outcome. Learn directly from the official preprocessed 41×480 waveform. A learned strided convolution mixes sensors and samples, followed by three small temporal convolutions, learned pooling readout and a three-class head. There is one decoder, without FFT, engineered band powers, base ensembles, recognition, fine-tuning during prediction, count correction or CSP. Its lightweight session readout reads/writes the same fixed-size causal prototype state as F1. Also score the same weights with every session write blank and with age-matched source donor history.

- Compare `raw_masked` with `raw_supervised`. Both train on the same 600 shuffled source episodes of 96 windows that exclude the tenth person, with seeds 460/1460, same waveform model, source losses and per-window masked span. The extra objective predicts the normalized latent tokens of a hidden one-second span from the remaining waveform. Its target is a detached exponential-moving-average copy of the same learned convolution. Both train the auxiliary head. Only `raw_masked` propagates that gradient into the encoder. The auxiliary loss weight is 0.20. Both smoke the gradient difference and discard the auxiliary head and target copy at inference. There is no evaluation-time use of training metadata or hidden labels.
- Primary predicts raw_masked minus raw_supervised +1.5 pp (80% −0.7 to +3.7) whole balanced accuracy across ten held people and eight pinned orders, and raw_masked minus F3 chronological +3.0 pp (−0.5 to +6.5). Genuine minus matched blank +1.0 pp (−0.7 to +2.7). Report P04/P10, early prefix decision contributions, and comparison to complete cap250 stock. A secondary identical 0.20 terminal insertion measures whether any errors recovered complement cap250. Predict insertion minus stock +0.05 pp (−0.55 to +0.65). Support a directional contrast only if both seeds' paired people/order lower 80% limits exceed zero, and refute if both upper limits are nonpositive. Other outcomes are undecided. Whole population performance drives candidate selection.
- Ferranti paired 4-step source and causal smoke followed by two 20-fit H100 arrays, each capped at four simultaneous five-minute tasks. Recompute held inference independently on Galvani. Verify exact zero-stock, raw effective parameter updates, source fit exclusion, one-window/prefix/reset parity and blind banks. Reserve independent external accuracy and paired incremental A100 runtime for a candidate that closes the gap to cap250. No upload.

[Recent masked EEG pretraining reference](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/20a917f77773ac0fa8bea2bdd6606b66-Abstract-Conference.html)

## F8 · Train the raw decoder with synthetic session styles

Registered 18 November 2026 before F8 fitting. Does changing plausible cross-channel session statistics while preserving each real trial's temporal trace and source task label improve held-person decoding? F4 perturbed within-window time and §439 changed sensor gains. F8 draws a different source person's session as a style donor and transfers a bounded portion of its channel covariance. Use class-balanced covariances of the training windows, with 0.25 isotropic shrinkage and a mixing coefficient 0.25. The transform acts on time-demeaned voltages then restores the original means. The core synthetic intervention changes co-variation between sensors. Its `raw_style_diagonal` control matches the expected per-channel post-transform variance on the fitted covariance, without cross-channel mixing. A code-generated transformation offers auditable task/participant provenance. No generated windows enter evaluation.

- `raw_style_full` and `raw_style_diagonal` reuse the F7 supervised raw decoder, two seeds, 600 episode updates and exactly the same source candidates and matched auxiliary computation. Transform half the training episodes. Fix the matching style donor draw and all episode/supervision seeds. Compare F7 raw_supervised as the unaugmented control. Score all ten held people and eight pinned deliveries, genuine, blank and donor, with whole decoder primary and the same full-stack terminal readout secondary.
- Predict full minus diagonal +0.85 pp (80% −0.7 to +2.4) whole, +0.12 (−0.35 to +0.59) full, and full minus unaugmented +1.25 (−0.7 to +3.2) whole. Positive paired people/order 80% lower limits at both seeds support, nonpositive uppers at both refute; otherwise undecided. Report exact dose, direction/activity, active optimizer steps, no held-source overlap, P04/P10 and first-window/late contribution.
- Ferranti source smoke and two 20-fit arrays, five minutes per task and cap four per array. Galvani independent held inference and frozen branch replay. Use only source-fitted transformations and original public recordings. External confirmation and A100 one-window timing required before a release. No upload.

[Generative augmentation with held-person evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22733)

## F9 · Learn how quickly to normalize a new session

Registered 18 November 2026 at 14:30 CET before production F7 outcomes. The earlier single filter-bank decoder gained about four official points from causal normalization, while its incremental ensemble gain was unresolved (§323). F9 tests a small, learned version inside the raw temporal decoder. Keep the F7 supervised architecture and losses. On the learned 32-dimensional embedding, add a variance-normalized readout using sufficient statistics of previous delivered windows in the current session. Add the change in the shared static logits to the original readout. At window one the change is exactly zero. Unit-variance, zero-mean source pseudocounts stabilize the start. The learned arm trains one count per feature, initialized at 20 and bounded by 20×exp(±2). The fixed arm uses 20 for every feature. Scale never uses unseen-person labels. Both keep the same session-mean and second-moment storage, variance floor 0.25, and ±2 per-feature adjustment limit.

- Fit source-only using F7's two seeds, 600 matched episodes, unchanged task and matched-detached auxiliary objectives. Evaluate the same ten people, eight pinned orders, genuine/donor/blank and original F7 raw_supervised on authenticated predictions. Predict learned minus fixed +0.60 pp (80% −0.50 to +1.70) on whole-model balanced accuracy, fixed minus F7 supervised +1.50 pp (−0.50 to +3.50), learned genuine minus donor +0.60 (−1.0 to +2.2). Also report the first-window contribution, next nine windows and later parts relative to blank. Full-stack terminal readout remains secondary. Positive paired people/order lower bounds at both seeds support, nonpositive uppers at both refute, otherwise undecided.
- Verify inherited raw actor weights initialize identically, first-window identity with F7, active learned prior gradients and count updates, fixed 20, source-exclusion, one-window/prefix/reset and zero-stock/pinned order. Ferranti two-arm smoke, then two source-fit arrays after the F7 production dependency. Held scores on Galvani and external evidence before release. No upload.

**F-C4 completed.** On the exact worker and canonical Scherer deliveries, balanced pseudo-class loss weights gained +0.119 pp [80% −0.162,+0.417] versus stock and +0.261 pp [−0.139,+0.655] versus anti-balanced. Both contrasts remain undecided. All 4,260 stock labels and work counts matched. Warm paired time was 0.9934× stock. [External report](../friday/cap250-c4-result.md)

## F10 · Transfer the normalization update alone into cap250

Registered 18 November 2026 after F9 standalone results and before inspecting F10 outputs. All raw terminal insertions trailed cap250 despite F9 fixed normalization improving over blank and donor on both seeds. Test whether the normalization update transfers once we remove the other raw logits from the insertion. Freeze both F9 fixed-prior checkpoint banks. Use the exact same source-only weights, delivered embeddings and history in both readouts. Subtract the parent `RawDecoder.read` output from `NormalizedRawDecoder.read`. This isolates only the normalized feature change through the same static weight matrix. Center across classes, clip each logit to ±1 and multiply by 0.10 before applying the result to the exact §430 cap250 terminal log probabilities. Use genuine prefix, the same F9 source-donor history, and zero. Unlike §443, this subtraction removes the waveform model's prototype and style reads even when they are active. It tests fixed normalization at the latent readout, using the F9 parameterization.

- Evaluate ten held-new people, eight pinned shuffled deliveries and seeds 460/1460. Predict genuine minus stock +0.08 pp (80% −0.20 to +0.36) and genuine minus donor +0.10 pp (−0.15 to +0.35) FULL-SYSTEM DEV. Positive lower paired people/order limits on both seeds support each contrast, nonpositive uppers on both refute, otherwise undecided. Report P04/P10, order sensitivity, changed labels and the first-window zero. Comparison to the F9 whole-model logit insertion is diagnostic because those outcomes are exposed.
- Verify actor hash, original F9 logits/stock decision equivalence, held-excluded roster and training rows, canonical ages, genuine/donor state, exact zero and first-window parity, and nonzero normalization term. Seal all decisions before computing scores. One Galvani CPU smoke and two parallel paired-seed CPU jobs. If gains advance, qualify returning and exact-worker external utility and runtime before changing the submission. No upload.

## F11 · Adapt sensor scale before the raw waveform encoder

Registered 18 November 2026 before F11 outputs. F9 fixed embedding normalization improved over both blank and donor. Test whether removing session amplitude variation earlier helps the learned raw convolutions. Within each source fold fit the per-channel reference centered power from its nine labeled training people using the existing cell/class weights. For a query, estimate the per-channel power of preceding windows with 20 reference pseudowindows. Multiply the current window's time-centered voltage by the square root of reference power divided by causal power, clipped to gains 0.5–2. Restore the original channel means. This is label-free online and is identity on the first window. Keep the F7 raw waveform decoder, task training objective and matched-detached auxiliary objective. Train two matched arms for 600 episodes and seeds 460/1460. The genuine arm estimates prior power from earlier windows in the current source episode. Its control uses earlier windows from a different source person, at the same age and under the same initial reference. F4/F8 changed training distributions without a corresponding earlier-layer update on unseen recordings. F9 normalized learned features after the temporal encoder.

- Evaluate both models as whole decoders with genuine prior, age-matched donor prior and identity at the sensor layer. The actor above that layer replays the same genuine prototype history and its own blank comparison where relevant. Compare with the locked F7 raw-supervised genuine result. Use all ten held people and eight deliveries. Predict genuine-trained model with real sensor history minus donor-trained model with real sensor history +0.80 pp (80% −0.70 to +2.30), and genuine-trained minus F7 +1.00 (−1.00 to +3.00) WHOLE DEV. Within identical genuine-trained weights, predict real sensor history minus donor +0.75 (−0.75 to +2.25). Full cap250 insertions secondary. Positive lower paired people/order bounds on both seeds support, nonpositive upper bounds on both refute, otherwise undecided.
- Require source-only power reference and donor fit rosters, shared seeds and episode rows, exact first-window sensor identity, active scaling, per-window logit equivalence, causal prefix and fresh reset. Ferranti source smoke and two source arrays, Galvani held score after checkpoint authentication. Any possible submission advance requires independent utility and exact worker measurements. No upload.

## F13 · Limit persistent artifact influence in the original causal FBCNet

Registered 18 November 2026 before F13 replay or scoring. Replay the exact §323 S1C checkpoints across both seeds and ten held people from the original source lock. This is the trained session-normalized FBCNet, active 287-feature skip, original raw scale and k=20 causal BatchNorm. Earlier §332 isolated mean and variance, §378 chose source-estimated variance shrinkage for P0, and §395 corrected output logits. F13 changes only the influence of unusually energetic past windows in S1C's actual normalization layer. Each activation channel retains full current-window weight. A previous window's weight is one up to four times its frozen population variance in squared energy about its population mean, then falls inversely with energy. Use the same weight for its first moment, second moment and effective count. Keep the k=20 population prior and the original current readout. The purpose is to prevent brief high-energy artifacts from dominating later session statistics. First-window behavior is identical by construction. No checkpoint, training, raw tensor, pooling or task-head changes.

P has log mean power at integer 4–36 Hz. X adds absolute normalized bispectra for (f,f,2f), f=4–18 Hz. D permutes only the harmonic phase among frames, keeping each frame’s harmonic magnitude and fundamental; B independently rotates harmonic phase at each frame/bin, preserving all amplitudes. Use deterministic controls shared across trials. Four source-trained whole readouts and six source-person holdouts (§407 RBF/weights). Reserve cross-interface confirmation: separately train on Graz of five source people, test BrainHero of sixth and vice versa, all six rotations.
